video_title: Post Game Press Conference l Ausar Thompson l Pistons at Hornets   11.04.26 #NBA

quotes.speaker: Ausar Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Ausar Thompson on Pistons' slow start and second-half progress
quotes.excerpt: in the second half we started doing that and we saw progress
quotes.quote: We were playing slow to start. We were not playing together. We were not moving it too much and in the second half we started doing that and we saw progress.
quotes.social_post: Ausar Thompson says the Pistons were playing slow and not moving the ball early against the Hornets, but he saw progress in the second half when they started playing together.

structured.context: Ausar Thompson discusses the Pistons' slow start and their improved ball movement in the second half of the game against the Hornets.

quotes.speaker: Ausar Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Ausar Thompson on team's offensive struggles and maintaining pressure
quotes.excerpt: just being able to get to the next action even when the shots aren't falling
quotes.quote: We are still figuring those things out, just being able to get to the next action even when the shots aren't falling and keep putting pressure on the other team.
quotes.social_post: Ausar Thompson on the Pistons offensive struggles: We are still figuring those things out and just need to get to the next action even when the shots are not falling.

structured.context: Ausar Thompson explains the team's need to maintain offensive pressure even when shots are not falling.

quotes.speaker: Ausar Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Ausar Thompson on John Collins' versatility and offensive impact
quotes.excerpt: he's able to spread the court, hit threes, catch lobs, set screens, roll and in the post
quotes.quote: He's able to spread the court, hit threes, catch lobs, set screens, roll and in the post, he's able to get his own bucket. So, he's super dynamic and I feel I'm going to try to do a better job of feeding him.
quotes.social_post: Ausar Thompson calls John Collins a super dynamic player who can spread the court and get his own bucket, adding that he needs to do a better job of feeding him the ball.

structured.context: Ausar Thompson praises teammate John Collins for his dynamic offensive versatility and ability to score in multiple ways.

quotes.speaker: Ausar Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Ausar Thompson on playing against elite rim protectors like Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: how high I jump, how athletic I am, how I could get to the cup shouldn't affect
quotes.quote: It really shouldn't. I feel like how high I jump, how athletic I am, how I could get to the cup shouldn't affect what I do. Obviously he's a good defender, but I trust myself up there.
quotes.social_post: Ausar Thompson says playing against elite rim protectors should not change his game: I trust myself up there.

structured.context: Ausar Thompson reflects on his confidence in attacking the rim despite facing elite defenders like Joel Embiid.

quotes.speaker: Ausar Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Ausar Thompson on increasing aggression and pushing the pace
quotes.excerpt: I definitely could do that a little bit more, just to push our pace especially when
quotes.quote: I definitely could do that a little bit more, just to push our pace especially when we don't have anything going. But first I got to grab rebounds and push them. I need to make sure they don't get offensive rebounds and if they crash, they send four to the glass, that means we have a lot of numbers going on the other end.
quotes.social_post: Ausar Thompson says he needs to focus on grabbing rebounds to help push the pace for the Pistons: I definitely could do that a little bit more.

structured.context: Ausar Thompson discusses his personal goal to increase aggression and push the pace by securing defensive rebounds to create transition opportunities.
